strings.从备份、只读检查、复制环境修复、差异审阅、SQLite 验证、插件验证到灰度和回: Migration process from backup, read-only inspection, copy environment repair, diff review, SQLite validation, plugin validation to canary and rollback.
strings.OpenClaw 2.0：先过迁移 Gate，再谈原地升级: OpenClaw 2.0: Pass the Migration Gate First, Then Talk About In-Place Upgrade
strings.实测表明 doctor --fix 会改配置结构、模型路由、默认并发、Skill: Testing shows that doctor --fix modifies config structure, model routing, default concurrency, Skill state, and SQLite; do not try it directly in the production directory
strings.全部通过后才扩大流量: Only after all pass, expand traffic
strings.doctor 还写入 maxConcurrent=8、compaction 等默: doctor also writes defaults such as maxConcurrent=8, compaction
strings.风险：容量、行为与 GitOps diff 同时变化: Risk: capacity, behavior, and GitOps diff change simultaneously
strings.模型路由的“名字相同，语义可能不同”: Model routing: "same name, semantics may differ"
strings.风险：插件未安装/未授权时模型路由直接失败: Risk: model routing fails directly when plugin is not installed/authorized
strings.共享状态与会话进一步迁入 SQLite STRICT: Shared state and sessions further migrate into SQLite STRICT
strings.升级后创建的会话不一定被旧运行时识别: New sessions may be unreadable by the old runtime
strings.风险：只回滚二进制，不等于回滚数据: Risk: rolling back only the binary does not equal rolling back data
strings.doctor --fix 的写入范围可能越界: doctor --fix write scope may exceed boundaries
strings.state-dir 隔离不约束配置中的绝对 workspace: state-dir does not restrict absolute workspace paths
strings.TOOLS.md、AGENTS.md 等工作区文件可能被迁移: Workspace files such as TOOLS.md, AGENTS.md may be migrated
strings.风险：副本配置仍指向生产路径时会误改生产文件: Risk: when replica configuration still points to production path, it may mistakenly modify production files
strings.插件与 Provider 边界重组: Reorganization of plugin and Provider boundaries
strings.官方 Provider 拆包；能力声明需要显式同意: Official Provider split; capability consent is explicit
strings.OpenProse 与 /prose 移除；SDK 旧导入将退役: OpenProse and /prose removed; old SDK imports will be retired
strings.风险：插件可加载 ≠ 功能可用，需逐项回归: Risk: plugin loadable ≠ feature available; need item-by-item regression
strings.会话 reset、主动记忆/梦境、并发与审批发生变化: Session reset, memory/dreaming, concurrency, approvals change
strings.缺依赖 Skill 在 --fix 下可被批量禁用: Skills with missing dependencies can be batch-disabled under --fix
strings.风险：升级成功但业务行为静默漂移: Risk: upgrade succeeds but business behavior silently drifts
strings.会话缺失 / 模型路由变化 / 插件 capability 未批准 / Cron: Missing sessions / model routing changes / plugin capability not approved / Cron duplicate or missed runs / Gateway connection failure / SQLite validation failure
strings.回滚动作必须同时覆盖：旧二进制 + 旧配置 + 升级前数据快照；禁止只替换 np: Rollback action must cover simultaneously: old binary + old configuration + pre-upgrade data snapshot; replacing only the npm package is prohibited

strings.60 Step 收敛实验：Train Loss 继续下降，Validation: 60-step convergence: train loss falls, validation rebounds
strings.DeepSeek V4 Flash · 2 节点 × 8 GPU · EP=16: DeepSeek V4 Flash · 2 nodes × 8 GPUs · EP=16 · GDRDMA · validation every 10 steps
strings.结论：继续压低 Train Loss 不等于泛化继续改善；保存间隔应与验证间隔对: Conclusion: continuing to lower Train Loss does not mean generalization continues to improve; the save interval should be aligned with the validation interval.

strings.NCCL 微基准：链路能力与真实训练收益要分开看: NCCL Microbenchmark: Distinguish Link Capability from Real Training Gains

strings.对应 DP / FSDP / ZeRO 的梯度与参数同步: Corresponds to gradient and parameter synchronization for DP / FSDP / ZeRO
strings.对应 MoE Expert Parallel 的 Token Dispatch: Corresponds to Token Dispatch / Combine for MoE Expert Parallel
strings.注意：GB/s 是 16 Rank Collective 的算法带宽，不是单张网: Note: GB/s is the algorithmic bandwidth of the 16-rank collective, not the line rate of a single NIC, nor the end-to-end training speedup.

strings.真实 MoE SFT：三轮 A/B 都显示 RDMA 更快: Real MoE SFT: all three A/B rounds show RDMA is faster

strings.口径：相同节点、模型、数据、Batch、镜像与 Rank 映射；仅切换 NCCL: Basis: same nodes, model, data, batch, image, and rank mapping; only NCCL transport is switched.

strings.为什么同一套 RDMA，一组没收益，另一组快 32%？: Why does the same RDMA setup yield no benefit for one group, yet a 32% speedup for another?
strings.决定因素不是“有没有 RDMA”，而是关键 Collective 是否跨节点并进: The deciding factor is not 'whether RDMA is present', but whether key collectives span nodes and enter the critical path of the step.
strings.EP 与 DP 组留在单节点: EP and DP groups stay on a single node
strings.跨机只传 Pipeline Activation: Only pipeline activations are transmitted across machines
strings.EP 与 Dense DP 都跨两节点: Both EP and Dense DP span two nodes
strings.All-to-All + 同步进入跨机路径: All-to-All + synchronization enter the cross-machine path
strings.拓扑图只展示通信域关系；每个节点实际使用 8 张 GPU。: The topology diagram only shows communication domain relationships; each node actually uses 8 GPUs.

strings.预算推算，不调用 API，也不发送输入数据。: Budget estimate. No API calls; no input data is sent.
strings.请填写有效的非负数，任务数与通过率须大于零。: Enter valid non-negative values; task count and pass rate must be positive.
strings.Search 与 Fetch 各按 0.005 元／成功请求计算。调用次数可以填: Search and Fetch each cost CNY 0.005 / successful request. Call counts may be averages; estimate model and execution costs separately.
